summary: Authenticate Release verification and prepare exact pre-commit standard updates

delivery.outcome: Goal authenticates canonical GitHub Release metadata, resolves latest final standards immutably, prepares only staged-ticket-authorized pre-commit updates, and atomically adopts wellmanifest/new-project without weakening fail-closed validation.
nonGoals: Do not bypass tag, revision, draft, prerelease or publication-time checks
Do not expose credentials in output
Do not stage, commit or publish a prepared update automatically
Do not alter the historical ticket-063 lifecycle prose; its protected merge receipt remains terminal truth

architecture.decision: Resolve an existing GitHub CLI credential only for canonical Release HTTPS requests, bind latest to a peeled annotated tag, require exact staged adoption evidence before pre-commit mutation, then apply the published generator and abort for review.
architecture.rollback: Revert the credential resolver and pre-commit protocol together; explicit pinned adoption remains available.

validation.evidence: Focused test verifies an Authorization header without printing its value.
Existing unavailable and invalid metadata tests remain green.
The exact published lock, generated required-check declaration and host bindings validate together.
